import json, sys
rec = json.load(open('rcos-invocation-route-record-validate.json'))
checks = []
def need(cond, name):
    checks.append({'check': name, 'ok': bool(cond)})
    if not cond:
        json.dump({'schema': 'a2c-invocation-check/1', 'ok': False, 'checks': checks}, open('validation-report.json', 'w'), indent=2)
        sys.exit(1)
need(rec.get('capability_id') == 'route-record-validate', 'capability is route-record-validate')
need(rec.get('status') == 'completed', 'invocation completed')
need(rec.get('mode') == 'normal', 'normal mode (not eval)')
need(rec.get('registry_status') == 'promoted', 'capability promoted at run time')
c = rec.get('contract') or {}
need(len(c.get('declaration_errors') or []) == 0 and len(c.get('contract_errors') or []) == 0, 'contract clean')
need((c.get('input') or {}).get('status') == 'pass' and (c.get('output') or {}).get('status') == 'pass', 'contract io pass')
report = {'schema': 'a2c-invocation-check/1', 'ok': True,
          'invocation_id': rec.get('invocation_id'),
          'capability_id': rec.get('capability_id'),
          'registry_status': rec.get('registry_status'),
          'mode': rec.get('mode'), 'status': rec.get('status'),
          'duration_ms': rec.get('duration_ms'),
          'eligibility_eligible': (rec.get('eligibility') or {}).get('eligible'),
          'checks': checks}
json.dump(report, open('validation-report.json', 'w'), indent=2)
print('verify-invocation ok:', rec.get('invocation_id'))
PYEOF
